text: Kingsmoor FC tuvo una gran oportunidad tras una jugada larga con 11 pases desde un saque de banda. Viktor Quinlan le dio un pase corto a Felix Duarte, quien disparó cerca del arco desde 4 metros, pero su tiro se fue desviado. Esta fue una ocasión clara, ya que la expectativa de gol (xG) era de 0.827, lo que significa que un disparo así suele terminar en gol muchas veces [#713]. El partido sigue empatado 2-2 y Kingsmoor intenta presionar con pases precisos y juego por las bandas.

- Felix Duarte missed a big chance with an xG of 0.827, shooting off target from 4.1 meters with his foot during open play [#713].
- The chance came after a 56.5-second build-up with 11 passes starting from a throw-in by Kingsmoor FC [#695-#713].
- Viktor Quinlan provided a short assist to Felix Duarte for the shot [#710].
- At the time of the missed chance, the score was tied 2-2 between Kingsmoor FC and Westport Albion.
- In the last 10 minutes, Kingsmoor FC had 52.4% possession and created 1 big chance with 3 shots but no shots on target.

- The big chance for Kingsmoor FC originated from a sustained build-up involving 11 passes over 56.5 seconds, beginning with a throw-in and progressing patiently through the midfield with short passes among multiple players (Rahman, Zielinski, Fairweather, Strand, Sato, Quinlan) showcasing fluid ball retention and movement [#695-#713].
- The pattern reflects Kingsmoor FC's 4-4-2 formation and wide, crossing play style under coach Pablo Iriarte, as the attack was built out wide and involved progressive carries and a final third long pass from Hamza Strand to Viktor Quinlan, who provided a short assist to striker Felix Duarte in a central area 4.1m from goal for a high-quality chance (xG 0.827) [#702, #709, #710, #713].
- Westport Albion, set up also in a 4-4-2 but favoring direct vertical passing under Grace Oduya, allowed Kingsmoor to maintain possession and patiently build their attack rather than winning the ball back quickly or pressing high, as indicated by their higher PPDA and more turnovers in the last 10 minutes.
- The chance missed by Duarte despite good positioning and support illustrates how Kingsmoor's patient and wide build-up created opportunities close to goal but lacked the clinical finishing to convert this key moment [#713].
